title: Design System: Ground Truth by ACAPS

display.purpose: The question itself (max 22ch, balanced) and the answer word in the confirmation plate. One per screen.

headline-embed.purpose: The question inside the partner embed card; reused as the moderator workbench display size for the inspector risk title (max 36ch, balanced).

title.purpose: Section headings under 3px rules, answer labels, disclosure summaries, button labels.

body.purpose: Explanatory copy and notes, 58 to 62ch, tabular figures.

label.purpose: Field labels, fact values, tab labels, risk badges. Sentence case, no tracking.

small.purpose: Fact keys, metadata, hints, anonymity strip, footnotes.

code.purpose: System monospace stack, only for the embed code snippet. Real code, never a technical costume.

shadows.name: rule-inset-1
shadows.purpose: Outline of empty rating cells and completion tracks. A rule, not elevation.

shadows.name: rule-inset-2
shadows.purpose: Outline of the Low risk badge.

shadows.name: tab-underline
shadows.purpose: Selected tab underline, drawn inside the blue cell.

shadows.name: node-hover
shadows.purpose: Thickens a hovered radar node's 2px border. A rule, not elevation.

shadows.name: value-tag
shadows.purpose: Boxes the lens value inside a radar node; also the 1px outline of a Low level swatch.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system.

motion.name: button-fill
motion.purpose: Button background and colour on hover.

motion.name: followup-rise
motion.purpose: Note and Send appearing after a selection.

motion.name: plate-wipe
motion.purpose: Ink plate wiping across the selected answer, and across the selected radar node on the moderator workbench.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

layout.maxWidthModerator: 1440px, set as --max on a wrapper around the whole moderator page so band, context strip, main and footer widen together
layout.stickyAnswering: top = min(24px, viewportHeight - columnHeight - 24px) at 1024px and up
layout.moderatorBench: DOM order radar, inspector, queue; one column gap 32px below 1024px; from 1024px 7:5 with areas "radar inspector" / "queue inspector", gap 48px

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per state (Send, Next question). Signal blue with a white label and an ink border; never black.

narrative.overview:
Ground Truth is set like an International Typographic Style information poster: one objective unit, flush left, on one grid, in one grotesk. A signal-blue band with white type over a heavy black rule announces the asker; a paper ground carries the question at display size; white fields with square 2px ink borders hold the three answers. Nothing is rounded, nothing floats, nothing is tinted for mood. Rank comes from weight, case and reversal, never from extra sizes or colours.

The system's one theatrical act is reversal. Choosing an answer wipes a solid ink plate across that answer from the left, and the sent confirmation is the same plate at display size. Everything else stays light so that plate is unmistakable. States that are not yet confirmed (pending ACAPS review, queued offline) keep the plate's shape but stay hollow.

The question is a portable unit. The same structure (asker band, question, Yes / No / Don't know, answer-by date) is set again, cell for cell, as the WhatsApp message, the plain-text email, the partner embed card and the 1200x630 share card. New surfaces inherit that unit rather than inventing a new one.
keyCharacteristics: Signal-blue band with white type, 3px ink rule, paper ground, white fields, ink text.
One grotesk (Archivo) at three sizes; weight 400/500/700/800 does the ranking.
Square corners everywhere in the product's own chrome; 2px control borders, 3px section rules, 1px hairlines inside groups.
The chosen element is the screen's only reversed ink plate: the answer on the expert page, the selected risk on the moderator workbench.
Flat: no elevation shadows. Depth is rules and reversal.
One question unit, transposed identically across page, WhatsApp, email, embed and OG card.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: A solid ink fill behind white text marks the chosen element, exactly one per screen. On the expert page that is the chosen answer (the option plate, then the sent plate); on the moderator workbench it is the selected radar node, wiped in with the same 260ms scaleX. No other in-content element may be a reversed ink plate. The black anonymity strip and the moderator context strip are shell chrome, not content, and are the only exceptions.

rules.name: The Vermilion Means Danger Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only for High risk and for error marks. It is never decoration, never an accent, never a link colour.

rules.name: The No Grey Words Rule
rules.body: Text is ink or soft ink on light grounds, white or bright blue on ink, white on signal blue. Hairline greys are for rules and tracks, never for words.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Display, body (17px) and small (13px) are the only sizes on the page. A new level of hierarchy is made with weight or reversal, never with a fourth size. (The embed headline is the display size of the embed and of the moderator workbench, which sets no display-size question; it is never an extra step on a page that already has one.)

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels, no letter-spaced captions, no kicker lines above headings. A heading is a weight-800 title at body size, sitting under a rule.

rules.name: The Rules Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: If something needs to separate from its ground, give it a border or a rule at one of the three weights. Never a drop shadow, never a hard offset shadow.

dos: **Do** keep exactly one reversed ink plate per screen, on the chosen element: the answer (option plate, then sent plate) on the expert page, the selected radar node on the moderator workbench. The anonymity strip and the moderator context strip are the only other ink grounds, and they are chrome.

**Do** mark not-yet-counted states as hollow plates: dashed 2px ink for pending ACAPS review, solid 2px ink for queued. Proposed radar risks and links and expert proposals in the queue are dashed for the same reason.
**Do** make the primary action signal blue with a white label and a 2px ink border.
**Do** carry any new transport of a question as the same unit: blue band with mark and risk, question, Yes / No / Don't know, answer-by date.
**Do** head every section with a 3px ink rule and a weight-800 title at body size.
**Do** keep square corners and the 3px / 2px / 1px border weights for all product chrome.
**Do** keep text in ink or soft ink; put a source line beside every rating.
donts: **Don't** fill a button, card or badge with ink; black belongs to the chosen element (the answer, or the selected radar node).
**Don't** use vermilion for anything but High risk and error marks.
**Don't** add a fourth type size; rank with weight or reversal.
**Don't** set uppercase or letter-spaced labels, or kicker lines above headings.
**Don't** add rounded corners, drop shadows or hard offset shadows to product chrome (medium-faithful WhatsApp previews keep their own rounding).
**Don't** introduce a second display face or a second accent colour.
